messages:
Anya: BIG NEWS — closed our first Redwood Dedicated enterprise contract! 12-month commitment, $300k ARR 🎉🙌
Sam: wait WHAT. that is amazing, congrats team!! :tada:
Giorgio: this calls for a very loud gong and questionable snacks. when do we celebrate?
Ellie: donuts or cake? (I will personally bring napkins)
Maya: can we get a keytar? asking for a friend.
Anya: lol keytar optional. planning a small in-office shindig Thurs 3pm.
Sam: can we make it coffee + tiny percussion? :drum: :coffee:
Anya: poll — react with your fav: 🍩 = donuts, 🍰 = cake, ☕ = coffee
(Giorgio reacted with 🍩)
(Ellie reacted with 🍰)
(Maya reacted with ☕)
Sam: I voted ☕ but will eat cake, truly a hero.
deploy-bot: prod-dedicated rollout for customer-xyz completed successfully at 1823456990 — all health checks green ✅
Anya: shoutout to infra + sales for the midnight handoff — you all crushed it.
Giorgio: gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-team-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA (paste to Slack at the party)
Ellie: tiny reminder — please HQ folks come by by 2:45 so we can set up tables.
Maya: can someone bring forks? also if remote, join the Zoom 3:05 for a virtual slice :slice_of_pizza:
Sam: RSVP yes (remote) — will bring confetti noises (air horn app)
Anya: thanks everyone, seriously huge milestone for product and ops. one small step for Redwood, one giant leap for predictable inference ✨
Giorgio: celebratory emoji flood: :tada: :sparkles: :confetti_ball: :guitar_emoji_not_really:
Ellie: adding this to the handbook under 'team rituals: celebrate wins with snacks' :book:
